column1: # SOURCE: https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-11  (page title: "NFL Week 11 Schedule 2026: Games, Times, Matchups & Tickets")
# Read via the fetch tool, chunks 0-2 of 3, on 2026-11-19 (UTC). Transcribed by session arena/427c1843-x1 (round 7).
# One row per fixture as PRINTED by the official page on 2026-11-19. All 13 fixtures print status "Scheduled"
# (no final scores). The page's "Teams on Bye" block prints ATL 3-7, CLE 6-4, GB 6-4, LA 6-4, NE 5-5, SEA 6-4;
# those rows are transcribed in official_w11_byes_2026_11_19.tsv, not derived here.
# tools/verify_2026_11_19.py check A6 asserts 13 x 2 + 6 byes = 32 clubs each exactly once.
# away_record / home_record are the records printed beside each club logo on THIS page. They are cross-checked
# against the separate standings page read the same day (official_standings_2026_11_19.tsv) by check A3:
# 32/32 agree on 2026-11-19, including MIA 1-8 and TB 3-6, so the two pages are consistent today.
# (An earlier draft of this header guessed that MIA/TB would disagree. The check measured it and they do
# not; the guess was removed rather than published.)
# Records print without the tie segment when the club has no ties; transcribed as printed.
# Venue is not printed by this page for any Week 11 fixture and stays blank rather than guessed.
